title.zh-CN: 肢端发凉与手指僵硬 · 16岁7个月女孩
title.en: Cold hands and feet and stiff fingers · girl aged 16 years 7 months

summary.zh-CN: 一名16岁女孩手脚发凉6年、手指发僵2年，双手和前臂的皮肤越来越紧，右手又有一个破口：分清轻重缓急，查明病因和受累器官，并在较长的病程中做出治疗与安全决策。
summary.en: A 16-year-old girl with six years of cold hands and feet, two years of stiff fingers, tightening skin on her hands and forearms and now a sore on her right hand: sort out what is urgent, find the cause and the organs involved, and make the treatment and safety decisions of a long course.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不作个体诊疗或自行用药的依据。病程和结果来自原报告，未记录的生理变化不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: A historical case review for clinical education, not a basis for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把雷诺伴新发指端坏死识别为严重指端缺血，当天开始抢救——保暖、保护伤口、止痛和静脉伊洛前列素——并在48小时内紧急评估（BSR 2024；EULAR 2023），不在入院当天截指，也不让她回家等门诊。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise new digital necrosis with Raynaud's as critical digital ischaemia and start same-day rescue — warmth, wound protection, analgesia and IV iloprost — with urgent assessment within 48 hours (BSR 2024; EULAR 2023), without amputating on admission or sending her home to clinic.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分原发与继发雷诺，把高滴度颗粒型ANA加抗U1-RNP阳性、抗Sm/dsDNA/Scl-70/Jo-1阴性解读为混合结缔组织病（重叠病）模式，并说明为什么矛盾的CK值要带参考区间复查。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish secondary from primary Raynaud's, interpret a high-titre speckled ANA with anti-U1-RNP and negative anti-Sm, dsDNA, Scl-70 and Jo-1 as an MCTD (overlap) pattern, and explain why conflicting CK values must be repeated with a reference range.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为以硬皮病样表现为主的抗U1-RNP重叠病筛查危及生命的器官并发症——含DLCO的肺功能和HRCT评估间质性肺病，超声心动图评估肺动脉高压，测血压、查肾功能——而不是只拍胸片或看炎症指标（SHARE 2021；ESC/ERS 2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Screen an anti-U1-RNP overlap with scleroderma features for its life-threatening organ complications — lung function with DLCO and HRCT for ILD, echocardiography for pulmonary hypertension, blood pressure and kidney function — rather than a chest X-ray or inflammatory markers (SHARE 2021; ESC/ERS 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤之后仍难治的病情选择升级治疗（利妥昔单抗或吗替麦考酚酯；SHARE 2021，EULAR 2023），并说明为什么长期大剂量激素或停用治疗是错误的。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose escalation for disease refractory to glucocorticoids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate (rituximab or mycophenolate; SHARE 2021, EULAR 2023) and explain why months of high-dose glucocorticoid or stopping treatment are wrong.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在清除B细胞前完成安全核查——HBsAg和抗-HBc（利妥昔单抗说明书），丙肝、HIV和IGRA（EULAR 2022），至少提前2周补种灭活疫苗、不接种活疫苗（EULAR/PReS 2021；ACR 2022），并查基线免疫球蛋白、做妊娠试验、落实避孕。
learningOutcomes.en: Complete the safety checklist before B-cell depletion — HBsAg and anti-HBc (rituximab label), hepatitis C, HIV and an IGRA (EULAR 2022), non-live vaccines at least 2 weeks before and no live vaccine (EULAR/PReS 2021; ACR 2022) — with baseline immunoglobulins, a pregnancy test and contraception.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 与青少年患者沟通：单独、保密地谈月经、性生活和避孕，用通俗的话解释一种慢性病和一种远期获益不确定的治疗，并用回授法确认理解。
learningOutcomes.en: Communicate with an adolescent: see her alone and in confidence about periods, sex and contraception, explain a chronic illness and a treatment of uncertain long-term benefit in plain words, and check understanding by teach-back.

chiefComplaint.en: Cold hands and feet for six years, stiff fingers for two years and a right-hand ulcer for one month

triageNote.zh-CN: 16岁女孩，今天收住病房。手脚发凉6年；近2年手指发僵，伸展困难；右手溃疡1个月，右拇指近期出现一处坏死区。体重、生命体征和过敏史尚未记录。
triageNote.en: 16-year-old girl admitted to the ward today. Cold hands and feet for six years; stiff fingers for two years, hard to straighten; a right-hand ulcer for a month, with a recent necrotic area on the right thumb. Weight, vital signs and allergies are not yet recorded.

tags.en: Necrotic area on the right thumb

personality.zh-CN: 16岁女孩，手脚凉了好几年，这两年手指发僵、伸不直，右手又破了，这次住院心里有些害怕。说话简短直接，问什么答什么；自己不清楚的事就直说说不上来，从不瞎猜。
personality.en: A 16-year-old girl whose hands and feet have been cold for years; for two years her fingers have been stiff and hard to straighten, and now there is a sore on her right hand. Being admitted frightens her a little. She answers briefly and directly, only what she is asked; when she does not know something she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 青少年的日常口语，短句，不用医学术语；说不出药名，只说“好几种药”。
speechStyle.en: Everyday teenage speech in short sentences, no medical terms; she cannot name her medicines and calls them 'several kinds of medicine'.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我手脚凉了好多年了，这两年手指发僵，伸不直，右手还破了一个口子。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my hands and feet have been cold for years, my fingers have been stiff for two years and won't straighten properly, and now there's a sore on my right hand.

concerns.zh-CN: 我的大拇指会不会保不住？
concerns.en: Am I going to lose my thumb?

concerns.zh-CN: 我的手以后还能正常用吗？
concerns.en: Will my hands ever work properly again?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：她躺在病房床上，话不多但说得清楚；一提到“拇指”或“手术”就明显紧张。只回答被问到的内容；不提任何检查结果和数字，不编造药名、剂量、过敏、月经、疫苗、家族史或症状细节（遇冷变色、疼痛程度、气短、吞咽、无力、皮疹都没有记录，一律说说不上来）。到了“病程与疗效”阶段，她说用了好几种药，手凉和发僵都没看出明显好转；到了随访阶段，她说受凉时手没以前那么难受了，拇指那块也没有再坏下去。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: she lies on the ward bed and says little, but clearly; any mention of her thumb or an operation clearly frightens her. She answers only what she is asked; she never mentions test results or numbers and never invents medicine names, doses, allergies, periods, vaccines, family history or symptom details (colour changes in the cold, how much it hurts, breathlessness, swallowing, weakness and rashes are not recorded, so she is not sure). In the course stage she says she has had several kinds of medicine but the cold hands and the stiffness have not clearly got better; at follow-up she says her hands are not as bad in the cold as they were and the bit on her thumb has not got any worse.

description.zh-CN: 她刚收住病房：采集病史，检查双手、双足和关节，判断今天什么不能等并付诸行动，送出首批检查。
description.en: She has just been admitted to the ward: take her history, examine her hands, feet and joints, decide what cannot wait today, act on it and send the first tests.

description.zh-CN: 首批血液检查的结果可以调阅了（在这一阶段重新开单即可看到）：解读抗体和肌酶，判断这是哪一类疾病，并决定还要评估哪些器官。
description.en: The first blood results can now be read (order them again in this stage to see them): interpret the antibodies and muscle enzymes, decide what kind of disease this is and which organs must now be assessed.

description.zh-CN: 器官评估、皮肤和肌肉病理以及此前治疗的记录可以调阅了：看她对治疗的反应，决定下一步，并在新的治疗开始前做好安全准备。
description.en: The organ assessments, the skin and muscle pathology and the record of her treatment so far can now be read: see how she has responded, decide the next step and make it safe before it starts.

description.zh-CN: 查阅本病例记录的后续治疗和一年随访；更远期的情况没有记录。
description.en: Read the further treatment and the one-year follow-up this case records; nothing beyond that is recorded.

name.zh-CN: 后续治疗与一年随访记录
name.en: Further treatment and one-year follow-up record

text.zh-CN: 加用利妥昔单抗，共两次。此后雷诺现象改善，右拇指坏死没有继续加重；病程记录写ANA和抗nRNP转阴。化验汇总表（加用后）：B淋巴细胞计数0.00（未写单位），ENA和nRNP阴性，CRP 9.5 mg/L，血小板123×10⁹/L，胸片仍有间质改变。随访1年，没有过敏反应或感染的记录；远期疗效和安全性仍不确定。
text.en: Rituximab was added: two administrations. Afterwards her Raynaud's phenomenon improved and the necrosis of the right thumb progressed no further; the case notes record ANA and anti-nRNP as having become negative. Results table (after rituximab): B-lymphocyte count 0.00 (no unit given), ENA and nRNP negative, CRP 9.5 mg/L, platelets 123 × 10⁹/L, and the chest film still showing interstitial changes. Over one year of follow-up no allergic reaction or infection is recorded; long-term efficacy and safety remain uncertain.

note.zh-CN: 利妥昔单抗的剂量和两次之间的间隔、预处理、用药前是否做过感染筛查或疫苗接种、同时继续使用了哪些药、免疫球蛋白水平、治疗后的肺功能或CT、僵硬的变化以及拇指是否愈合，本病例都没有记录。病程记录写ANA转阴，汇总表写的是ENA。
note.en: The rituximab doses and interval, premedication, any infection screening or vaccination beforehand, which treatments continued alongside it, immunoglobulin levels, lung function or CT after treatment, the course of her stiffness and whether the thumb healed are not recorded. The case notes say ANA became negative; the results table names ENA.

name.zh-CN: 保暖、保护坏死的拇指并止痛
name.en: Keep her warm, protect the necrotic thumb and relieve pain

dose.zh-CN: 病房保暖，戴手套、穿袜子；坏死区保持干燥，用不粘伤口的敷料保护，避免受压和碰撞；按需止痛；避免受凉、吸烟和收缩血管的药物（如含伪麻黄碱的感冒药）。
dose.en: A warm room, gloves and socks; keep the necrotic area dry under a non-adherent dressing, free of pressure and knocks; analgesia as needed; no cold exposure, smoking or vasoconstricting drugs such as pseudoephedrine decongestants.

response.zh-CN: 护士已让她保暖，拇指已包扎保护，止痛药按需备好。本病例没有记录疼痛评分或这些护理措施；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The nurse has her warm, the thumb dressed and protected, and pain relief charted as needed. This case records no pain score and none of these measures; it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉滴注伊洛前列素（前列环素类似物）

dose.zh-CN: 按体重以纳克/千克/分计算，从低速开始，每日持续静滴数小时，按耐受情况（头痛、潮红、低血压）逐步调整，连用数天；按本院方案配制，输注期间监测血压。她的体重本病例没有记录。
dose.en: Weight-based in nanograms per kg per minute: start at a low rate, infuse over several hours a day and titrate to tolerance (headache, flushing, hypotension) on several consecutive days; made up per the unit's protocol, with blood pressure checks during the infusion. Her weight is not recorded.

response.zh-CN: 伊洛前列素已开始静脉滴注，护士在监测血压。本病例没有记录她当时是否用过前列环素类药物；不模拟用药后的变化。
response.en: The iloprost infusion is running and the nurse is checking her blood pressure. This case does not record whether she received a prostanoid at the time; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 口服，按年龄和体重从小剂量开始，监测血压、头痛和潮红；禁止与硝酸酯类合用。
dose.en: By mouth, starting low for her age and weight, watching blood pressure, headache and flushing; never with a nitrate.

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服西地那非。本病例没有记录她是否用过PDE5抑制剂；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Sildenafil started by mouth. This case does not record whether she had a PDE5 inhibitor; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 口服硝苯地平（长效制剂）

dose.zh-CN: 长效制剂口服，从小剂量开始，按血压、头痛、潮红和踝部水肿的情况逐步加量。
dose.en: A modified-release preparation by mouth, starting low and increased as blood pressure, headache, flushing and ankle swelling allow.

response.zh-CN: 已开始口服硝苯地平。本病例没有记录她是否用过钙通道阻滞剂；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Nifedipine started by mouth. This case does not record whether she had a calcium-channel blocker; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 请手外科（整形外科）会诊坏死的拇指
name.en: Hand (plastic) surgery review of the necrotic thumb

dose.zh-CN: 请手外科评估坏死范围和有无感染，与风湿科一起制定伤口护理计划；坏死分界清楚之前一般先保守处理。
dose.en: Ask the hand surgeons to assess the extent of the necrosis and any infection and to agree a wound-care plan with rheumatology; until the necrosis demarcates, care is usually conservative.

response.zh-CN: 手外科已收到会诊申请。本病例没有记录是否请过外科会诊；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Hand surgery has the request. This case does not record whether a surgical review took place; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 立即手术截除坏死的右拇指
name.en: Amputate the necrotic right thumb now

dose.zh-CN: 请外科今天在手术室截除右拇指的坏死部分及其近端组织。
dose.en: Ask the surgeons to remove the necrotic part of the right thumb and the tissue proximal to it in theatre today.

harm.zh-CN: 干性坏死、没有记录感染时，截指不是第一步：先保暖、止痛、保持干燥，并用扩血管药挽救尚有血供的组织，让坏死自行分界；现在手术会切在缺血的组织上，伤口可能长不好，失去的往往比需要的更多，而且无法挽回。BSR 2024把严重指端血管病变伴新发组织坏死列为急症，需要风湿科紧急评估（最好在48小时内）；外科手术在严重缺血或难治性溃疡中可以有作用，但要与外科共同决定，而不是入院当天就截。
harm.en: With dry necrosis and no recorded infection, amputation is not the first step: warmth, pain relief, keeping it dry and a vasodilator salvage what still has a blood supply while the necrosis demarcates; operating now cuts through ischaemic tissue that may not heal and can lose more than was needed — irreversibly. BSR 2024 treats severe digital vasculopathy with new tissue necrosis as an emergency for urgent rheumatological assessment, preferably within 48 hours, and gives surgery a role in critical ischaemia or refractory ulceration — a decision taken with the surgeons, not on the day of admission.

response.zh-CN: 已提出手术申请。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；之后的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Operation requested. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 戴手套保暖，出院后门诊随访
name.en: Warm gloves and discharge to outpatient follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 嘱咐戴手套、避免受凉，开出院，两周后风湿科门诊复诊。
dose.en: Advise gloves and avoiding the cold, discharge her, and review her in the rheumatology clinic in two weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 新出现组织坏死的严重指端缺血是急症：BSR 2024要求紧急评估（最好在48小时内）。不在院内开始扩血管治疗、让她回家等两周后的门诊，会错过挽救手指的时机，也会耽误查找背后的结缔组织病。
harm.en: Severe digital ischaemia with new tissue necrosis is an emergency: BSR 2024 asks for urgent assessment, preferably within 48 hours. Sending her home to a clinic two weeks away, with no vasodilator begun in hospital, loses the time in which the digit can be saved and delays the search for the connective-tissue disease behind it.

response.zh-CN: 已安排出院。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；之后的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Discharge arranged. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 监测血压、肾功能和尿液
name.en: Monitor blood pressure, kidney function and urine

dose.zh-CN: 按固定间隔测血压并记录；用糖皮质激素期间定期查肾功能和尿常规；血压升高立即报告。
dose.en: Chart her blood pressure at set intervals and check kidney function and urine regularly while she is on glucocorticoids; report any rise in blood pressure at once.

response.zh-CN: 护士已按固定间隔记录血压，并送检肾功能和尿常规。本病例没有记录她的血压和肾功能；不模拟读数。
response.en: The nurse is charting her blood pressure at set intervals, and kidney function and urine are requested. This case records neither her blood pressure nor her kidney function; it does not simulate readings.

name.zh-CN: 单独、保密地谈月经、性生活与避孕
name.en: A private, confidential talk about periods, sex and contraception

dose.zh-CN: 单独与她谈（请陪同的人暂时回避），保密地询问月经和性生活；说明甲氨蝶呤、环磷酰胺、吗替麦考酚酯等药物可致畸、环磷酰胺可损伤卵巢功能，讨论可靠的避孕方法和生育力保护。
dose.en: Seeing her on her own (anyone with her asked to step out), ask in confidence about periods and sexual activity; explain that methotrexate, cyclophosphamide and mycophenolate can harm a pregnancy and that cyclophosphamide can damage the ovaries, and discuss reliable contraception and fertility protection.

response.zh-CN: 已单独、保密地完成谈话。本病例没有记录这次谈话、她的月经情况或避孕安排。
response.en: The conversation has taken place privately and in confidence. This case records neither the conversation nor her periods or contraception.

name.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素（与改善病情药联用）

dose.zh-CN: 按体重计算口服，与改善病情药联用，炎症活动期过后逐步减量；用药期间定期测血压、血糖并查肾功能。
dose.en: A weight-based oral dose alongside a disease-modifying drug, tapered once the inflammatory phase settles, with regular blood pressure, glucose and kidney checks.

response.zh-CN: 已开始糖皮质激素。本病例记录她用过糖皮质激素，但没有记录剂量、途径和疗程；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Glucocorticoid started. This case records that she received glucocorticoids but not the dose, route or duration; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 每周一次（口服或皮下注射），按体表面积计算，同时补充叶酸；用药前查血常规、肝肾功能和妊娠试验，并落实避孕。
dose.en: Once a week (by mouth or subcutaneously), dosed by body surface area, with folic acid; check the blood count, liver and kidney function and a pregnancy test first, and make sure of contraception.

response.zh-CN: 已开始每周一次的甲氨蝶呤。本病例记录她用过甲氨蝶呤，但没有记录剂量和开始时间；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Weekly methotrexate started. This case records that she received methotrexate but not its dose or when it began; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 把激素加到大剂量并维持数月
name.en: Raise the glucocorticoid to a high dose and keep it there for months

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松加至大剂量并维持数月，作为难治性雷诺和手指僵硬的主要治疗。
dose.en: Prednisone raised to a high dose and kept there for months as the main treatment of the refractory Raynaud's and stiff fingers.

harm.zh-CN: 雷诺、指端缺血和皮肤纤维化是血管病变和纤维化，大剂量激素逆转不了，却会带来感染、骨质疏松、股骨头坏死、高血糖和库欣样改变，坏死组织也更难愈合。SHARE 2021（青少年系统性硬化症）把激素放在活动性炎症期、与改善病情药联用；血管病变用扩血管药（EULAR 2023），难治时换用或加用其他免疫抑制剂或生物制剂。
harm.en: Raynaud's, digital ischaemia and skin fibrosis are vasculopathy and fibrosis that high-dose glucocorticoids cannot reverse, while they bring infection, osteoporosis, avascular necrosis, hyperglycaemia and cushingoid change and slow the healing of necrotic tissue. SHARE 2021 (juvenile SSc) places glucocorticoids, with a disease-modifying drug, in the active inflammatory phase; the vasculopathy is treated with vasodilators (EULAR 2023), and refractory disease with another immunosuppressant or a biologic.

response.zh-CN: 处方已开出。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；之后的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Prescribed. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 按体重计算静脉输注，按本院方案控制滴速，监测输液反应、头痛和肾功能。
dose.en: A weight-based intravenous infusion at the rate the unit's protocol sets, watching for infusion reactions, headache and kidney function.

response.zh-CN: 免疫球蛋白已开始输注。本病例记录她用过免疫球蛋白，但没有记录剂量、途径和时间；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The immunoglobulin infusion has started. This case records that she received immunoglobulin but not the dose, the route or when; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 按体表面积计算的静脉冲击，充分水化并用美司钠预防出血性膀胱炎；之前确认未怀孕、落实避孕，并讨论生育力保护（如同时使用GnRH激动剂）。
dose.en: IV pulses dosed by body surface area with hydration and mesna against haemorrhagic cystitis; pregnancy excluded and contraception in place first, and fertility protection discussed (such as a GnRH agonist alongside).

response.zh-CN: 环磷酰胺已开始输注。本病例记录她用过环磷酰胺，但没有记录剂量、途径、疗程和时间；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The cyclophosphamide infusion has started. This case records that she received cyclophosphamide but not the dose, route, number of courses or timing; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 利妥昔单抗前补种灭活疫苗（流感、肺炎球菌等）
name.en: Non-live vaccines before rituximab (influenza, pneumococcal and others due)

dose.zh-CN: 核对接种记录，补种到期的灭活疫苗（如流感、肺炎球菌疫苗）；在不耽误必要治疗的前提下尽量在利妥昔单抗之前完成，接种后至少2周再输注利妥昔单抗。
dose.en: Check her vaccination record and give the non-live vaccines she is due (such as influenza and pneumococcal), before rituximab where this does not delay needed treatment, with at least 2 weeks between vaccination and the infusion.

response.zh-CN: 已补种灭活疫苗，利妥昔单抗安排在接种至少2周后。本病例没有记录她的接种史或用药前是否补种过疫苗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Non-live vaccines given; rituximab is scheduled at least 2 weeks later. This case records neither her vaccination history nor any vaccines before rituximab; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 利妥昔单抗前接种减毒活疫苗（麻腮风或水痘）
name.en: Live attenuated vaccine (MMR or varicella) before rituximab

dose.zh-CN: 在利妥昔单抗之前接种一剂麻腮风或水痘减毒活疫苗。
dose.en: One dose of MMR or varicella live attenuated vaccine before the rituximab.

harm.zh-CN: 她已用过糖皮质激素、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤，还用过免疫球蛋白，接下来要清除B细胞：减毒活疫苗可能引起疫苗株播散感染，应答也会被削弱。EULAR/PReS 2021要求免疫抑制的患儿避免减毒活疫苗，ACR 2022建议使用免疫抑制药期间推迟活疫苗；利妥昔单抗前应补的是灭活疫苗。
harm.en: She has had glucocorticoids, cyclophosphamide, methotrexate and immunoglobulin and is about to have her B cells depleted: a live attenuated vaccine can cause disseminated vaccine-strain infection, and her response would be blunted. EULAR/PReS 2021 asks for live attenuated vaccines to be avoided in immunosuppressed children, and ACR 2022 advises deferring them while immunosuppressive drugs are taken; what she needs before rituximab are the non-live vaccines.

response.zh-CN: 疫苗已接种。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；之后的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Vaccine given. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 按体重或体表面积计算的方案静脉输注，共两次（本病例记录用了两次，剂量和间隔没有记录）；输注前用对乙酰氨基酚、抗组胺药和糖皮质激素预处理，并监测输液反应。
dose.en: IV infusion by a weight- or body-surface-area-based regimen, two administrations (this case records two; their doses and interval are not recorded), with paracetamol, antihistamine and glucocorticoid premedication and monitoring for infusion reactions.

harm.zh-CN: 没查乙肝（HBsAg、抗-HBc）就用利妥昔单抗：清除B细胞可使隐匿的乙肝再激活，发展为暴发性肝炎甚至死亡。利妥昔单抗说明书的黑框警告（2013年FDA安全通报后加入）要求首剂前查HBsAg和抗-HBc；EULAR 2022（成人）建议开始抗风湿药物前明确乙肝状态，据此决定抗病毒治疗。结核（首选干扰素释放试验）、丙肝和HIV筛查以及基线免疫球蛋白，也应在首剂前完成。
harm.en: Rituximab without hepatitis B testing (HBsAg, anti-HBc): B-cell depletion can reactivate occult hepatitis B into fulminant, sometimes fatal hepatitis. Rituximab's boxed warning (added after the FDA's 2013 safety communication) requires HBsAg and anti-HBc before the first dose, and EULAR 2022 (adults) asks for hepatitis B status to be defined before antirheumatic drugs start, to decide on antiviral treatment. TB (an interferon-gamma release assay preferred), hepatitis C and HIV screening and baseline immunoglobulins also belong before the first dose.

response.zh-CN: 利妥昔单抗已在预处理后开始输注，护士在观察有无输液反应。本病例记录用了两次利妥昔单抗；之后的情况见随后的记录（本病例不模拟其效果）。
response.en: The rituximab infusion is running after premedication, with the nurse watching for an infusion reaction. This case records two rituximab administrations; what followed is in the records that come next (the case does not simulate it).

dose.zh-CN: 口服，从小剂量开始逐步加到目标剂量（按体表面积或体重计算）；用药前查妊娠试验并落实可靠避孕，监测血常规和肝功能。
dose.en: By mouth, starting low and building up to a target dose (by body surface area or weight); a pregnancy test and reliable contraception first; monitor the blood count and liver tests.

response.zh-CN: 已开始吗替麦考酚酯。本病例记录的治疗中没有吗替麦考酚酯，之后的记录按实际病程展开；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Mycophenolate started. Mycophenolate is not among the treatments this case records, and the records that follow show the course as it happened; it does not simulate the effect.

hint.zh-CN: 让她自己讲：每个问题持续了多久，手指和皮肤有什么变化，受凉时手指会怎样——还有哪些地方可能也受到了影响？
hint.en: Let her tell it: how long has each problem lasted, what has changed in her fingers and skin, what happens to her fingers in the cold — and what else might be affected?

guidance.en: Go to her bedside and take the history.

title.zh-CN: 检查她的双手、双足和关节
title.en: Examine her hands, feet and joints

hint.zh-CN: 仔细看皮肤、手指和甲床的颜色、拇指和脚趾，关节能伸到什么程度，有没有摸得到的硬结。
hint.en: Look closely at the skin, the colour of the fingers and nail beds, the thumb and the toes, how far the joints straighten, and any hard deposits you can feel.

hint.zh-CN: 哪个发现今天就威胁到她身体的一部分？要多快处理？哪些首批检查能找到背后的原因？
hint.en: Which finding threatens a part of her body today, how quickly must it be dealt with, and which first tests will find the cause behind it?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策1，到床旁落实处置，并送出首批血液检查。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board, act on it at the bedside and send the first blood tests.

title.en: Make sense of the first results

hint.zh-CN: 抗体提示是哪一类疾病？肌酶能说明什么、不能说明什么？这种病可能在悄悄损害哪些器官？
hint.en: What do the antibodies say about the kind of disease, what can and can't you conclude from the muscle enzymes, and which organs could this disease be damaging silently?

guidance.zh-CN: 在这一阶段重新开单查看首批结果，作答决策2和决策3，并开出器官评估。
guidance.en: Order the first tests again in this stage to read their results, answer decisions 2 and 3, and order the organ assessments.

title.zh-CN: 回顾病程，安全地安排下一步
title.en: Review her course and plan the next step safely

hint.zh-CN: 她到目前为止对治疗反应如何？器官检查又补充了什么？更强的治疗开始前必须先查清什么？
hint.en: How has she responded so far, what do the organ results add, and what has to be checked before a stronger treatment starts?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅这一阶段的记录，作答决策4和决策5，再给予你选择的治疗。
guidance.en: Read the records of this stage, answer decisions 4 and 5, then give the treatment you chose.

hint.zh-CN: 后续治疗之后哪些变了、哪些没变？单个病例还留下哪些不确定？
hint.en: What changed after the further treatment, what did not, and what does a single case leave uncertain?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅随访记录，并问问她现在手怎么样。
guidance.en: Read the follow-up record and ask her how her hands are now.

prompt.zh-CN: 她右拇指有一处1×2 cm的干燥坏死区，左足第4趾皮肤发绀，甲床苍白，雷诺现象阳性；病因还不清楚。今天你怎么处理？
prompt.en: Her right thumb has a dry 1 × 2 cm necrotic area, the skin of the left fourth toe is cyanosed, the nail beds are pale and Raynaud's phenomenon is positive; the cause is not yet known. What do you do today?

need.zh-CN: 先问清破口的经过，并检查拇指。
need.en: Ask about the sore and examine the thumb first.

text.zh-CN: 按严重指端缺血当天处理：保暖、保护拇指、止痛，院内开始静脉伊洛前列素并加用PDE5抑制剂，请风湿科紧急会诊，同时送检
text.en: Treat it as critical digital ischaemia today: keep her warm, protect the thumb and relieve pain, start IV iloprost in hospital with a PDE5 inhibitor, ask rheumatology to see her urgently and send the first tests

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。BSR 2024把严重指端血管病变伴新发组织坏死列为急症，需要紧急评估（最好在48小时内）。先保暖、保持坏死区干燥并保护、充分止痛；EULAR 2023推荐用PDE5抑制剂和/或静脉伊洛前列素治疗指端溃疡，SHARE 2021也用伊洛前列素治疗青少年系统性硬化症的指端缺血。查找病因的检查同时进行，不能因此推迟挽救手指。
feedback.en: Right. BSR 2024 treats severe digital vasculopathy with new tissue necrosis as an emergency for urgent assessment, preferably within 48 hours. Warmth, a dry and protected digit and analgesia come first; EULAR 2023 recommends PDE5 inhibitors and/or IV iloprost for digital ulcers, and SHARE 2021 uses iloprost for ischaemic digits in juvenile SSc. The tests that find the cause run in parallel — they do not delay the rescue of the digit.

text.zh-CN: 请外科今天切除拇指的坏死部分，免得坏死组织扩散，同时用抗生素预防感染；等伤口缝合愈合以后再查找病因
text.en: Ask the surgeons to remove the necrotic part of the thumb today so the dead tissue cannot spread, cover her with antibiotics, and look for the cause once the wound has been closed and has healed

feedback.zh-CN: 今天不行。干性坏死、没有记录感染时，先内科处理：保暖、止痛并用扩血管药，挽救尚有血供的组织，等坏死自行分界。BSR 2024认为手术在严重缺血或难治性溃疡中可以有作用，但要之后与外科共同决定；现在截指会切在缺血组织上、无法挽回，没有感染征象时用抗生素也没有帮助。
feedback.en: Not today. Dry necrosis without recorded infection is treated medically first: warmth, analgesia and a vasodilator salvage what still has a blood supply while the necrosis demarcates. BSR 2024 gives surgery a role in critical ischaemia or refractory ulceration, decided with the surgeons later; amputating now cuts through ischaemic tissue and cannot be undone, and antibiotics without signs of infection add nothing.

text.zh-CN: 按指动脉血管炎处理，今天开始静脉甲泼尼龙冲击，同时保暖、保护拇指；三天后坏死仍在扩大，再加用扩血管药
text.en: Give IV methylprednisolone pulses today for a presumed vasculitis of the digital arteries, keep her warm and protect the thumb, and add a vasodilator only if the necrosis is still spreading after three days of steroids

feedback.zh-CN: 这里没有任何记录提示血管炎：伴硬指和钙质沉着的指端缺血属于硬皮病谱系的血管病变，要用扩血管药治疗（EULAR 2023）；等三天再用，会错过BSR 2024为新发坏死设定的处理时机。激素若要用，也是在明确炎症性疾病之后。
feedback.en: Nothing recorded here shows a vasculitis: digital ischaemia with sclerodactyly and calcinosis is the vasculopathy of the scleroderma spectrum, treated with vasodilators (EULAR 2023), and waiting three days for them wastes the window BSR 2024 sets for new necrosis. Glucocorticoids belong, if at all, to the inflammatory disease once it has been defined.

text.zh-CN: 嘱咐戴手套保暖，开始口服硝苯地平，然后让她出院，两周后带着抗体结果到风湿科门诊复诊；干性坏死比较稳定，不算急症，不必住院
text.en: Advise warm gloves and start oral nifedipine, then discharge her to the rheumatology clinic in two weeks with the antibody results, since a dry necrotic area is stable and not an emergency

feedback.zh-CN: 硝苯地平是雷诺现象的一线药物（EULAR 2023），但新出现的坏死并不稳定：BSR 2024把严重指端血管病变伴新发组织坏死列为急症，需要紧急评估（最好在48小时内）；回家等两周可能保不住手指。
feedback.en: Nifedipine is first-line for Raynaud's (EULAR 2023), but new necrosis is not stable: BSR 2024 calls severe digital vasculopathy with new tissue necrosis an emergency for urgent assessment, preferably within 48 hours, and two weeks at home risks losing the digit.

prompt.zh-CN: 首批结果：ANA 1:10000（颗粒型），抗nRNP ++，抗SSA +，抗Sm、抗dsDNA、抗Scl-70、抗Jo-1阴性，补体正常，CRP 0.5 mg/L；CK一处记为56 U/L，另一处记为556并标记升高。哪种解读最符合她的病情？
prompt.en: The first results: ANA 1:10000 (speckled), anti-nRNP ++, anti-SSA +, anti-Sm, anti-dsDNA, anti-Scl-70 and anti-Jo-1 negative, complement normal, CRP 0.5 mg/L; the CK is entered as 56 U/L in one place and as 556 flagged raised in another. Which reading of her illness fits best?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅这一阶段的抗体和肌酶结果。
need.en: Read the antibody and muscle-enzyme results of this stage first.

text.zh-CN: 抗U1-RNP重叠病引起的继发性雷诺，即以硬皮病样表现为主的混合结缔组织病模式；带参考区间复查CK，并马上评估肺、心、食管和肌肉
text.en: Secondary Raynaud's from an anti-U1-RNP overlap — a mixed connective tissue disease pattern with scleroderma features; repeat the CK with its reference range and look now at the lungs, heart, oesophagus and muscle

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。原发性雷诺不会引起指端坏死和硬指。高滴度颗粒型ANA合并抗nRNP（U1-RNP）阳性，抗Sm、抗dsDNA、抗Scl-70、抗Jo-1阴性，再加上雷诺和硬皮病样的双手，是混合结缔组织病的模式：日本2019年标准等MCTD诊断标准都以雷诺或手指肿胀加抗U1-RNP为基础，再看狼疮样、硬皮病样和肌炎样表现。她的硬指属于硬皮病样表现；肌肉是否受累取决于CK——它同时记为56和556，应带参考区间复查。
feedback.en: Right. Primary Raynaud's does not cause digital necrosis or sclerodactyly. A very high-titre speckled ANA with anti-nRNP (U1-RNP) and negative anti-Sm, anti-dsDNA, anti-Scl-70 and anti-Jo-1, in a girl with Raynaud's and scleroderma-like hands, is the MCTD pattern: MCTD criteria such as the Japanese 2019 criteria start from Raynaud's or swollen fingers with anti-U1-RNP and add lupus-, scleroderma- and myositis-like features. Her sclerodactyly is scleroderma-like; whether the muscle is involved hinges on a CK recorded as both 56 and 556, so repeat it with a reference range.

text.zh-CN: 原发性雷诺现象，ANA阳性只是偶然发现：拇指坏死是受冻所致，注意保暖即可，一年后复查抗体，再考虑有没有结缔组织病
text.en: Primary Raynaud's phenomenon with an incidental positive ANA: the thumb necrosis comes from cold exposure, so keep her warm and repeat the antibodies in a year before any connective-tissue disease is seriously considered

feedback.zh-CN: 原发性雷诺不会造成组织坏死、硬指或钙质沉着，ANA 1:10000合并抗nRNP阳性也不是偶然发现。SHARE 2021要求所有雷诺患儿查甲襞毛细血管镜和ANA，正是为了发现这样的继发病因；等一年会让她的器官受累无人筛查。
feedback.en: Primary Raynaud's does not cause tissue loss, sclerodactyly or calcinosis, and an ANA of 1:10000 with anti-nRNP is no incidental finding. SHARE 2021 asks for capillaroscopy and ANA in every child with Raynaud's precisely to find a secondary cause like this one; waiting a year leaves her organs unscreened.

text.zh-CN: 系统性红斑狼疮——ANA滴度很高，又有抗SSA阳性：复查补体和抗dsDNA，以羟氯喹作为长期治疗的基础，按狼疮的方案制定治疗和随访计划
text.en: Systemic lupus erythematosus, given the very high ANA titre and the anti-SSA: repeat the complement and anti-dsDNA, and plan lupus treatment with hydroxychloroquine as the anchor of her long-term care

feedback.zh-CN: 抗SSA和高滴度ANA可见于多种结缔组织病。她的抗Sm、抗dsDNA阴性，补体正常，也没有记录能确定狼疮的表现；抗nRNP加硬皮病样表现更符合重叠病。羟氯喹对严重指端缺血没有作用。
feedback.en: Anti-SSA and a high ANA occur across connective-tissue diseases. Anti-Sm and anti-dsDNA are negative, complement is normal and no lupus-defining feature is recorded, while anti-nRNP with scleroderma features fits an overlap; hydroxychloroquine does nothing for critical digital ischaemia.

text.zh-CN: 青少年皮肌炎：钙质沉着和肌酶升高都指向它，抗nRNP只是伴随现象；安排肌肉磁共振，尽快按皮肌炎开始治疗
text.en: Juvenile dermatomyositis: the calcinosis and the raised muscle enzymes point to it, so the anti-nRNP is a bystander; arrange a muscle MRI and treat her for dermatomyositis without delay

feedback.zh-CN: 青少年皮肌炎可以有钙质沉着，但这里没有记录皮疹或无力，CK读数也不确定；雷诺伴坏死、硬指和高滴度抗nRNP都不能用它解释。肌肉受累可能是重叠病的一部分，而不是全部。
feedback.en: Calcinosis occurs in juvenile dermatomyositis, but no rash or weakness is recorded and the CK reading is uncertain; Raynaud's with necrosis, sclerodactyly and a high-titre anti-nRNP are not explained by it. Muscle involvement may be one strand of an overlap, not the whole disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 你考虑抗U1-RNP相关的重叠病，以硬皮病样表现为主。她现在需要做哪些器官评估？
prompt.en: You suspect an anti-U1-RNP overlap with scleroderma features. Which organ assessment does she need now?

need.zh-CN: 先判断这是哪一类疾病。
need.en: Decide what kind of disease this is first.

text.zh-CN: 查含DLCO的肺功能和高分辨率CT看间质性肺病，超声心动图加NT-proBNP看肺动脉高压，测血压，查肾功能和尿常规，评估食管
text.en: Lung function with DLCO and a high-resolution CT for lung disease, an echocardiogram with NT-proBNP for pulmonary hypertension, blood pressure, kidney function and urine, and the oesophagus

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。间质性肺病和肺动脉高压是决定硬皮病谱系疾病预后的并发症。SHARE 2021指出含DLCO的肺功能和HRCT是发现间质性肺病的敏感方法，并要求青少年系统性硬化症至少每6个月查一次含DLCO的肺功能、超声心动图和肾功能；ESC/ERS 2022认为有系统性硬化症重叠特征的结缔组织病可考虑每年评估肺动脉高压风险。开始用激素后更要监测血压（EULAR 2023）。
feedback.en: Right. ILD and pulmonary hypertension are the complications that decide outcome in scleroderma-spectrum disease. SHARE 2021 names lung function with DLCO and HRCT as the sensitive tests for ILD and asks for lung function with DLCO, echocardiography and renal function at least every 6 months in juvenile SSc; ESC/ERS 2022 considers a yearly PAH risk evaluation in connective-tissue disease with SSc overlap features. Blood pressure matters all the more once glucocorticoids start (EULAR 2023).

text.zh-CN: 现在先拍一张胸片；只有她出现气短或血氧下降时，再查肺功能和超声心动图——她还年轻，CRP也不高，胸片足以看出所有真正要紧的肺部病变
text.en: A chest X-ray now, with lung function and an echocardiogram only if she becomes breathless or her oxygen saturation falls — she is young, her CRP is low, and an X-ray shows any lung disease that matters

feedback.zh-CN: 胸片对早期间质性肺病不敏感，症状又出现得晚——她有没有气短也没有记录。筛查应查含DLCO的肺功能加HRCT（SHARE 2021；ACR/CHEST 2023成人指南不建议用胸片筛查），并用超声心动图评估肺动脉高压（ESC/ERS 2022）。
feedback.en: A chest X-ray is insensitive for early ILD, and symptoms come late — her breathing is not recorded either way. Screening is lung function with DLCO plus HRCT (SHARE 2021; the adult ACR/CHEST 2023 guideline advises against screening with a chest X-ray), with echocardiography for pulmonary hypertension (ESC/ERS 2022).

text.zh-CN: 暂时不做器官检查：她CRP低、补体正常，说明病情不活动；三个月后复查抗体和CRP，升高了再查器官
text.en: No organ tests for now: her CRP is low and her complement normal, so the disease is not active; repeat the antibodies and CRP in three months and test organs if they rise

feedback.zh-CN: 在硬皮病谱系疾病中，CRP和补体不能反映器官受累；间质性肺病和肺动脉高压可以在炎症指标正常时悄悄进展。等三个月会失去日后治疗决策所需的基线（SHARE 2021）。
feedback.en: CRP and complement do not measure organ involvement in scleroderma-spectrum disease; ILD and pulmonary hypertension progress silently with normal inflammatory markers. Waiting three months loses the baseline that later treatment decisions need (SHARE 2021).

text.zh-CN: 先做肌肉磁共振、肌电图和肌肉活检，因为肌肉决定诊断；肺、心脏和肾脏等肌肉结果出来、弄清到底是什么病、活动度如何以后再查
text.en: A muscle MRI, EMG and muscle biopsy first, since the muscle decides the diagnosis; leave the lungs, heart and kidneys until the muscle result has shown what the disease really is and how active it is

feedback.zh-CN: 肌肉检查也许能明确肌炎这一部分，但不能代替对危及生命的并发症的筛查：肺、心脏和肾脏的评估应同时进行，而不是排在后面（SHARE 2021；ESC/ERS 2022）。
feedback.en: Muscle studies may define the myositis strand, but they do not replace the screen for the complications that threaten life: lung, heart and kidney assessment runs alongside, not after (SHARE 2021; ESC/ERS 2022).

prompt.zh-CN: 她用过糖皮质激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤，雷诺和僵硬仍没有明显改善；CT考虑有间质病变。下一步怎么办？
prompt.en: She has had glucocorticoids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate, yet her Raynaud's and stiffness have not clearly improved; the CT raises interstitial disease. What is the next step?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅这一阶段的治疗记录和胸部CT。
need.en: Read her treatment record and the chest CT of this stage first.

text.zh-CN: 在专科团队主持下升级治疗：完成感染筛查后加用利妥昔单抗清除B细胞，继续扩血管和伤口护理，并按固定间隔复查皮肤、手指和肺
text.en: Escalate under the specialist team: add B-cell depletion with rituximab once she has been screened for infection, keep the vasodilator and wound care going, and review her skin, digits and lungs at set intervals

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SHARE 2021建议严重或难治的青少年系统性硬化症考虑生物制剂，尤其是托珠单抗或利妥昔单抗；EULAR 2023把利妥昔单抗与吗替麦考酚酯、环磷酰胺并列用于皮肤纤维化和间质性肺病，因此吗替麦考酚酯也是合理的选择。先做感染筛查（首先是乙肝），扩血管和手指护理继续——免疫抑制治疗不了血管病变。
feedback.en: Right. For severe or refractory juvenile SSc, SHARE 2021 advises considering a biological agent, in particular tocilizumab or rituximab, and EULAR 2023 lists rituximab for SSc skin fibrosis and ILD alongside mycophenolate and cyclophosphamide — so mycophenolate is a reasonable alternative. Infection screening comes first (hepatitis B above all), and the vasodilator and digital care continue: immunosuppression does not treat the vasculopathy.

text.zh-CN: 把泼尼松加到大剂量并维持几个月，因为病情已经压过了其他药物；同时加用质子泵抑制剂和钙剂，门诊复查手指和皮肤
text.en: Raise prednisone to a high dose and keep it there for several months, since the disease has outrun the other drugs; add a proton-pump inhibitor and calcium, and review her fingers and skin in clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 大剂量激素逆转不了血管病变和纤维化，用上几个月还会给青少年带来感染、骨量丢失、股骨头坏死和库欣样改变。SHARE 2021把激素与改善病情药联用于活动性炎症期；难治时应换用其他药物，而不是长期大剂量激素。
feedback.en: High-dose glucocorticoids do not reverse vasculopathy or fibrosis, and months of them bring infection, bone loss, avascular necrosis and cushingoid change to an adolescent. SHARE 2021 uses glucocorticoids with a DMARD in the active inflammatory phase; refractory disease calls for another agent, not months of high doses.

text.zh-CN: 既然都没有效果，就停用所有免疫抑制药，只用扩血管药治疗雷诺；一年以后再复查CT，看肺部改变有没有进展，再决定要不要治疗肺
text.en: Stop the immunosuppressive drugs because none has helped, treat the Raynaud's with vasodilators alone, and repeat the CT in a year to see whether the lung changes progress before treating them

feedback.zh-CN: 无效是换药的理由，而不是停药的理由：抗U1-RNP重叠病的CT提示间质性肺病，需要治疗并密切随访，而不是等一年（EULAR 2023推荐吗替麦考酚酯、环磷酰胺或利妥昔单抗治疗系统性硬化症相关间质性肺病）。
feedback.en: Non-response is a reason to change treatment, not to stop it: a CT that raises ILD in an anti-U1-RNP overlap needs treatment and close follow-up, not a year's wait (EULAR 2023 lists mycophenolate, cyclophosphamide or rituximab for SSc-ILD).

text.zh-CN: 既然药物都失败了，肺又受累，马上转诊做大剂量免疫抑制加自体干细胞移植，等待期间停用其他治疗
text.en: Refer her now for high-intensity immunosuppression with autologous stem-cell transplantation, since the drugs have failed and the lungs are involved, and stop the other treatment while she waits for the transplant

feedback.zh-CN: 自体干细胞移植留给免疫抑制治疗无效、仍在进展的患者（SHARE 2021），或预后差、没有严重心肺受累的早期弥漫型系统性硬化症的特定患者（EULAR 2023）；它有治疗相关死亡风险，而且她还没有用过生物制剂。
feedback.en: Autologous stem-cell transplantation is kept for progressive disease refractory to immunosuppression (SHARE 2021) or selected early diffuse SSc with a poor prognosis and no advanced cardiorespiratory involvement (EULAR 2023); it carries treatment-related mortality, and a biologic has not yet been tried.

prompt.zh-CN: 计划使用利妥昔单抗。首次输注前必须做好哪些准备？
prompt.en: Rituximab is planned. What must be in place before the first infusion?

need.en: Decide the next step of treatment first.

text.zh-CN: 乙肝（HBsAg和抗-HBc）、丙肝、HIV和结核（IGRA）结果，基线免疫球蛋白，妊娠试验和避孕，并至少提前2周补种到期的灭活疫苗——不接种活疫苗
text.en: Hepatitis B (HBsAg and anti-HBc), hepatitis C, HIV and TB (IGRA) results, baseline immunoglobulins, a pregnancy test and contraception, and the non-live vaccines she is due at least 2 weeks ahead — no live vaccine

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。利妥昔单抗说明书有乙肝再激活的黑框警告，要求首次输注前查HBsAg和抗-HBc；EULAR 2022（成人）要求开始抗风湿药物前明确乙肝状态，并优先用IGRA筛查潜伏结核。EULAR/PReS 2021主张在不推迟必要治疗的前提下于免疫抑制前接种疫苗，免疫抑制的患儿避免活疫苗；ACR 2022要求灭活疫苗与利妥昔单抗之间至少间隔2周。
feedback.en: Right. Rituximab's prescribing information carries a boxed warning on hepatitis B reactivation and asks for HBsAg and anti-HBc before the first infusion; EULAR 2022 (adults) defines HBV status before antirheumatic drugs and prefers an IGRA for latent TB. EULAR/PReS 2021 vaccinates before immunosuppression where this does not postpone needed treatment and avoids live vaccines in immunosuppressed children, and ACR 2022 leaves at least 2 weeks between a non-live vaccine and rituximab.

text.zh-CN: 现在先打一剂麻腮风和水痘疫苗，让她在B细胞被清除前得到保护；注射部位消退后马上输注，输注前用对乙酰氨基酚和抗组胺药
text.en: A dose of MMR and varicella vaccine now, so that she is protected before her B cells are depleted, then the infusion as soon as the injection sites have settled, with paracetamol and an antihistamine first

feedback.zh-CN: 免疫抑制的患儿应避免活疫苗（EULAR/PReS 2021），使用免疫抑制药期间应推迟活疫苗（ACR 2022）：她用过激素、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤，接种麻腮风或水痘疫苗有疫苗株播散感染的风险，她用过的免疫球蛋白也会削弱应答。
feedback.en: Live vaccines are avoided in immunosuppressed children (EULAR/PReS 2021) and deferred while immunosuppressive drugs are taken (ACR 2022): after glucocorticoids, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate, MMR or varicella vaccine risks disseminated vaccine-strain infection, and the immunoglobulin she received can blunt the response.

text.zh-CN: 除了常规的血常规和肝功能，不需要别的：她用环磷酰胺时没出问题，只有首次输注后肝功能升高才需要做感染筛查
text.en: Nothing beyond her usual blood count and liver tests: she has already had cyclophosphamide without problems, so infection screening is needed only if her liver tests rise after the first infusion

feedback.zh-CN: 用过环磷酰胺没出问题，并不能说明乙肝情况：清除B细胞可使隐匿的乙肝再激活为暴发性肝炎，所以说明书要求首剂前查HBsAg和抗-HBc——等肝功能升高再查就晚了。
feedback.en: Previous cyclophosphamide says nothing about hepatitis B: B-cell depletion can reactivate occult HBV into fulminant hepatitis, which is why the prescribing information requires HBsAg and anti-HBc before the first dose — testing once the liver tests rise comes too late.

text.zh-CN: 拍胸片排除结核，输注前用对乙酰氨基酚、抗组胺药和糖皮质激素预处理；肝炎检查可以在首次输注后再做，因为再激活要几个月才会出现
text.en: A chest X-ray to rule out TB and premedication with paracetamol, an antihistamine and a glucocorticoid; hepatitis tests can follow the first infusion, since any reactivation takes months to appear

feedback.zh-CN: 胸片不能筛查潜伏结核（EULAR 2022优先推荐IGRA）；乙肝状态必须在首次输注前明确——再激活要靠事先决定的抗病毒预防来避免，而不是事后发现。
feedback.en: A chest X-ray does not screen for latent TB (EULAR 2022 prefers an IGRA), and hepatitis B status must be known before the first infusion: reactivation is prevented with antiviral prophylaxis decided in advance, not caught afterwards.

text.zh-CN: 问清主诉：手脚发凉、手指僵硬和破口各持续多久，手指和肘能伸到什么程度，关节有无肿胀，以及皮肤变紧
text.en: Took the presenting history: how long the cold hands and feet, the stiff fingers and the sore have lasted, how far the fingers and elbows straighten, any joint swelling and the tightening skin

text.zh-CN: 追问结缔组织病相关表现：遇冷变色、气短、吞咽、无力、皮疹以及眼干口干
text.en: Asked about the features of a connective-tissue disease: colour change in the cold, breathlessness, swallowing, weakness, rashes and dry eyes or mouth

text.zh-CN: 问了免疫抑制治疗所依赖的病史：用药、过敏、疫苗和水痘、肝炎或结核以及月经
text.en: Asked the history that immunosuppression depends on: medicines, allergies, vaccinations and chickenpox, hepatitis or TB, and periods

text.zh-CN: 检查了双手皮肤、手指颜色和甲床、坏死的拇指、脚趾、指肘关节和钙质沉着
text.en: Examined the skin of the hands, the finger colour and nail beds, the necrotic thumb, the toes, the finger and elbow joints and the calcinosis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认识到拇指坏死是当天就要处理的急症
text.en: Recognised the necrotic thumb as an emergency for today at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 在前两个阶段、病因尚未明确时就开始静脉伊洛前列素，并让手指保暖、干燥、受保护，同时止痛
text.en: Started IV iloprost and kept the digit warm, dry and protected with pain relief in the first two stages, before the cause was settled

text.zh-CN: 送检自身抗体、肌酶、血常规加CRP以及肾功能和尿常规
text.en: Sent the autoantibodies, muscle enzymes, blood count with CRP, and kidney function with urinalysis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把抗体模式判读为抗U1-RNP重叠病，并对矛盾的CK保持存疑
text.en: Read the antibody pattern as an anti-U1-RNP overlap at the first attempt, keeping the conflicting CK open

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对器官筛查，开出胸部CT和超声心动图，并调阅肺功能报告
text.en: Chose the organ screen at the first attempt, ordered the chest CT and echocardiogram and read the lung function report

text.zh-CN: 调阅病理后，首次作答即为难治性病情选对升级方案
text.en: Read the pathology and chose the escalation for refractory disease at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即列出利妥昔单抗前的核查清单，查了免疫球蛋白水平，并在输注前补种到期的灭活疫苗
text.en: Set out the pre-rituximab checklist at the first attempt, checked immunoglobulin levels and gave the due non-live vaccines before the infusion

text.zh-CN: 只在送出感染筛查之后才给予升级治疗（利妥昔单抗或吗替麦考酚酯）
text.en: Gave the escalation therapy (rituximab or mycophenolate) only once the infection screen had been sent

text.zh-CN: 避免了有害处置：入院即截指、让她出院等门诊、长期大剂量激素、接种活疫苗，或未做感染筛查就用利妥昔单抗
text.en: Avoided the harmful steps: amputating the thumb on admission, discharge to clinic, months of high-dose steroids, a live vaccine, or rituximab before the infection screen

text.zh-CN: 单独与她谈月经、性生活和避孕，并在使用致畸药物前送检妊娠试验
text.en: Saw her alone about periods, sex and contraception and sent a pregnancy test before teratogenic drugs

text.zh-CN: 用通俗的话向她解释病情、拇指的紧迫性和治疗计划，回应她的担忧并确认她听懂了
text.en: Explained the illness, the urgency for the thumb and the treatment plan to her in plain words, answered her worries and checked her understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge，必要时用SPIKES）：自我介绍，先问她已经知道什么、最担心什么（她怕保不住拇指、怕手以后不能正常用）；用通俗的话说明拇指缺血、今天的治疗是为了保住它、手术不是第一步；说明血液检查提示一种免疫病，可能也会影响肺和心脏，所以要查这些器官；谈到后续治疗时，说明为什么考虑更强的药（利妥昔单抗）、用之前要先查什么（乙肝、结核、疫苗、妊娠），以及远期疗效和安全性还不确定；主动提出单独、保密地谈月经、性生活和避孕（HEADSS）；最后用回授法确认她理解。不承诺一定能保住拇指或新药一定有效，不越过她只和大人谈，不用未解释的术语（硬皮病、间质性肺病）。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge, SPIKES where news is hard): introduces themself and first asks what she already knows and what worries her most (she fears losing her thumb and the use of her hands); explains in plain words that the thumb is short of blood, that today's treatment aims to save it and that an operation is not the first step; explains that the blood tests point to an immune disease that can also affect the lungs and heart, so those will be checked; for the later plan, sets out why a stronger medicine (rituximab) is considered, what is checked first (hepatitis, TB, vaccines, pregnancy) and that its long-term benefit and safety are uncertain; offers a confidential conversation on her own about periods, sex and contraception (HEADSS); checks understanding by teach-back. Does not promise that she will keep the thumb or that the new medicine will work, does not talk past her to an adult, and does not use unexplained jargon (scleroderma, interstitial lung disease).

name.zh-CN: 沈医生（儿童风湿免疫科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童风湿免疫科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“这个坏死的拇指今天最怕什么？要多快处理，用什么药？”“原发和继发雷诺靠什么区分？这组抗体排除了什么、指向什么？”“CK一处56、一处556，你能下什么结论、不能下什么结论？”“CRP正常能说明肺和肺循环没事吗？”“用过四种药都没明显好转，下一步怎么选？开始清除B细胞前必须查什么？”说明这是2013年发表的单例历史报告：病程和疗效只代表这一例，不能用来证明某种治疗普遍有效。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局。本病例没有记录体重、生命体征和血压、肾功能、DLCO和肺功能数值、CT扫描方式、甲襞毛细血管镜、感染筛查和疫苗、各药剂量和时间、利妥昔单抗的剂量和间隔、拇指是否愈合，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric rheumatology attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “What do you fear most for this necrotic thumb today — how fast must you act, and with what?”, “What separates primary from secondary Raynaud's, and what does this antibody panel rule out and point to?”, “The CK is 56 in one place and 556 in another — what can and can't you conclude?”, “Does a normal CRP tell you the lungs and the pulmonary circulation are spared?”, “Four drugs without clear improvement — how do you choose the next, and what must be checked before B-cell depletion?”. Explains that this is a single historical report published in 2013: its course and response belong to this one patient and cannot prove that a treatment works in general. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early. The case does not record weight, vital signs or blood pressure, kidney function, DLCO or lung-function values, the CT technique, capillaroscopy, infection screening or vaccines, the drug doses and timing, the rituximab dose and interval, or whether the thumb healed — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：16岁女孩今天收住病房；手脚发凉6年，手指僵硬2年、伸展困难，右手溃疡1个月，右拇指近期出现一处坏死区；体重、生命体征和过敏史尚未记录，请医生评估并下医嘱。可以协助：病房保暖、给坏死区换药包扎、按医嘱止痛、建立静脉通路、用输液泵输注伊洛前列素、免疫球蛋白或利妥昔单抗并按时测血压、送检标本、安排疫苗和妊娠试验，并按医嘱监测血压和肾功能。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（如血压、体重、用过的药的剂量）时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Paediatric ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): a 16-year-old girl admitted to the ward today; cold hands and feet for six years, stiff fingers for two years that are hard to straighten, a right-hand ulcer for a month and a recent necrotic area on the right thumb; weight, vital signs and allergies are not yet recorded; asks the doctor to assess her and write orders. Can help with a warm room, dressing the necrotic area, analgesia as ordered, IV access, iloprost, immunoglobulin or rituximab on an infusion pump with timed blood pressure checks, sending samples, arranging vaccines and a pregnancy test, and blood pressure and kidney monitoring as ordered. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (blood pressure, weight, doses of earlier medicines).

knowledge.zh-CN: 手外科会诊医生，只在被请来时会诊拇指。知道记录的所见：右拇指一处1×2 cm的干燥坏死区，左足第4趾皮肤发绀。可以讲：没有感染的干性坏死先保守处理——保暖、保持干燥、保护、止痛、扩血管治疗——等坏死分界清楚；清创可能促进溃疡愈合（BSR 2024）；截指等手术要在出现感染、难以控制的疼痛或坏死分界清楚后与风湿科共同决定。不说本病例没有记录的手术、感染或结局；本病例没有记录她是否看过外科。
knowledge.en: Hand surgeon who sees the thumb only when asked. Knows the recorded findings: a dry 1 × 2 cm necrotic area on the right thumb and a cyanosed left fourth toe. Can explain that dry necrosis without infection is managed conservatively — warmth, keeping it dry and protected, analgesia and vasodilator treatment — while it demarcates; that debridement may help an ulcer heal (BSR 2024); and that amputation or other surgery is decided with rheumatology for infection, uncontrolled pain or once the necrosis has demarcated. Never states an operation, infection or outcome the case does not record; whether she saw a surgeon is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 陆医生（儿童呼吸科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童呼吸科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的肺功能、胸部CT和胸片。可以讲：限制性通气功能障碍的含义，以及为什么还需要DLCO；CT报告写的是双上肺胸膜下小泡样气肿、考虑间质病变和食管扩张，扫描方式、间质改变的范围和类型以及肺功能的具体数值都没有记录；SHARE 2021认为含DLCO的肺功能和HRCT是发现间质性肺病的敏感方法，青少年系统性硬化症至少每6个月复查肺功能；胸片对早期间质性肺病不敏感。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric respiratory consultant who interprets only the lung function, chest CT and chest film the learner has already read. Can explain what a restrictive ventilatory impairment means and why DLCO is still needed; that the CT report reads small bubble-like emphysematous change beneath the pleura of both upper lobes, interstitial disease considered and a dilated oesophagus, while the technique, the extent and pattern of the interstitial change and the lung-function values are not recorded; that SHARE 2021 names lung function with DLCO and HRCT as sensitive for ILD and repeats lung function at least every 6 months in juvenile SSc; and that a chest film is insensitive for early ILD. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early and adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：指端坏死、抗U1-RNP重叠病与难治性病程
title.en: Debrief: digital necrosis, an anti-U1-RNP overlap and refractory disease

conclusion.zh-CN: 16岁7个月女孩，手脚发凉6年，手指僵硬2年、伸不直，双手和前臂皮肤越来越紧，右手溃疡1个月。查体：双手皮肤紧绷发硬，雷诺现象阳性，甲床苍白，右拇指1×2 cm干燥坏死区，左足第4趾皮肤发绀，指、肘关节伸展受限而无肿胀，指关节、肘和膝有钙质沉着及部分色素脱失。ANA 1:10000（颗粒型），抗nRNP ++，抗SSA +，抗Sm、抗dsDNA、抗Scl-70、抗Jo-1阴性，补体和CRP正常；CK一处记为56 U/L、一处记为556并标记升高。肺功能为限制性通气障碍，CT示双上肺胸膜下小泡样气肿、考虑间质病变并有食管扩张，心超未见肺动脉高压；皮肤活检符合硬皮病样改变，肌肉明显变性伴血管扩张。报告诊断为难治性儿童混合结缔组织病：糖皮质激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤治疗后雷诺和僵硬无明显改善；加用两次利妥昔单抗后雷诺改善、拇指坏死未再加重，病程记录写ANA和抗nRNP转阴，而汇总表记B淋巴细胞0.00、CRP 9.5 mg/L、血小板123×10⁹/L，胸片仍有间质改变。随访1年没有过敏或感染的记录，远期疗效和安全性仍不确定。今天的要点：新发指端坏死是当天就要扩血管抢救的急症；器官筛查靠含DLCO的肺功能、HRCT和超声心动图；清除B细胞之前先做乙肝等感染筛查并安排好疫苗。
conclusion.en: A girl aged 16 years 7 months had six years of cold hands and feet, two years of stiff fingers that would not straighten fully, skin on both hands and forearms that was getting tighter, and a right-hand ulcer for one month. On examination the skin of both hands was tight and firm, Raynaud's phenomenon was positive, the nail beds were pale, there was a dry 1 × 2 cm necrotic area on the right thumb and the skin of the left fourth toe was cyanosed; finger and elbow extension was limited without swelling, with calcinosis and areas of pigment loss at the finger joints, elbows and knees. ANA was 1:10000 (speckled) with anti-nRNP ++ and anti-SSA +, and anti-Sm, anti-dsDNA, anti-Scl-70 and anti-Jo-1 negative; complement and CRP were normal; the CK is recorded both as 56 U/L and as 556 flagged raised. Lung function showed a restrictive ventilatory impairment, CT showed small bubble-like emphysematous change beneath the pleura of both upper lobes with interstitial disease considered and a dilated oesophagus, and echocardiography showed no pulmonary hypertension; the skin biopsy was consistent with scleroderma-like change and the muscle showed marked degeneration with vascular dilatation. The report diagnosed refractory childhood mixed connective tissue disease: Raynaud's and stiffness did not clearly improve on glucocorticoids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate; after two rituximab administrations Raynaud's improved and the thumb necrosis progressed no further, and the case notes record ANA and anti-nRNP as negative, while the results table records a B-lymphocyte count of 0.00, CRP 9.5 mg/L, platelets 123 × 10⁹/L and a chest film still showing interstitial changes. No allergy or infection is recorded over one year; long-term efficacy and safety remain uncertain. For practice today: new digital necrosis is an emergency for same-day vasodilator rescue, the organ screen is lung function with DLCO, HRCT and echocardiography, and B-cell depletion follows hepatitis B and other infection screening and the right vaccines.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 雷诺伴新发组织坏死就是严重指端缺血：病因未明也要当天处理——保暖、保护、止痛、静脉伊洛前列素——并紧急评估。
keyReasoning.en: Raynaud's with new tissue necrosis is critical digital ischaemia: treat it the same day — warmth, protection, analgesia, IV iloprost — and assess urgently, before the cause is known.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 坏死、硬指、钙质沉着和1:10000颗粒型ANA使雷诺成为继发性；抗nRNP阳性而抗Sm、dsDNA、Scl-70、Jo-1阴性，指向以硬皮病样表现为主的抗U1-RNP重叠病（混合结缔组织病模式）。
keyReasoning.en: Necrosis, sclerodactyly, calcinosis and a 1:10000 speckled ANA make the Raynaud's secondary; anti-nRNP with negative anti-Sm, dsDNA, Scl-70 and Jo-1 points to an anti-U1-RNP overlap (the MCTD pattern) with scleroderma features.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 相互矛盾的记录（CK 56与556、HBDH 285与258、RF阳性与正常）保留而不强行取舍：依赖它们的决定要先带参考区间复查。
keyReasoning.en: Conflicting entries (CK 56 or 556, HBDH 285 or 258, RF positive or normal) are kept, not forced into one reading: a decision that rests on them needs a repeat with a reference range.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 硬皮病谱系疾病要逐个器官筛查——含DLCO的肺功能和HRCT、超声心动图、血压和肾功能——因为正常的CRP和补体说明不了肺和肺循环的情况。
keyReasoning.en: Scleroderma-spectrum disease is screened organ by organ — lung function with DLCO and HRCT, echocardiography, blood pressure and kidneys — because a normal CRP and complement say nothing about the lungs or the pulmonary circulation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤之后仍难治，应换用另一类药物（利妥昔单抗或吗替麦考酚酯），并且只在乙肝等感染筛查和疫苗安排妥当之后开始。
keyReasoning.en: Disease refractory to glucocorticoids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate calls for a different agent (rituximab or mycophenolate), started only after hepatitis B and other infection screening and the right vaccines.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这一例在利妥昔单抗后的好转——同时记录B淋巴细胞0.00、CRP 9.5 mg/L、血小板123×10⁹/L和胸片仍有间质改变——可供参考，但证明不了疗效或远期安全。
keyReasoning.en: This one patient's improvement after rituximab — recorded alongside a B-lymphocyte count of 0.00, CRP 9.5 mg/L, platelets 123 × 10⁹/L and persisting interstitial change — informs, but cannot prove, benefit or long-term safety.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 严重指端缺血（BSR 2024系统性硬化症指南；EULAR 2023系统性硬化症治疗建议；SHARE 2021青少年系统性硬化症建议）：严重指端血管病变伴新发组织坏死是急症，需要紧急评估，最好在48小时内。雷诺的一线药物是硝苯地平，BSR 2024把西地那非列为指端溃疡的一线药物；严重缺血用静脉伊洛前列素抢救（EULAR 2023：PDE5抑制剂和/或静脉伊洛前列素治疗指端溃疡；SHARE 2021：伊洛前列素治疗指端缺血）。清创可能促进愈合，手术要与外科共同决定。本病例没有记录她当时用过哪些扩血管药和伤口护理。
teachingPoints.en: Critical digital ischaemia (BSR 2024 guideline for systemic sclerosis; EULAR 2023 recommendations for the treatment of SSc; SHARE 2021 recommendations for juvenile SSc): severe digital vasculopathy with new tissue necrosis is an emergency for urgent assessment, preferably within 48 hours. Nifedipine is first-line for Raynaud's and BSR 2024 makes sildenafil first-line for digital ulcers; IV iloprost is the rescue for critical ischaemia (EULAR 2023: PDE5 inhibitors and/or IV iloprost for digital ulcers; SHARE 2021: iloprost for ischaemic digits). Debridement may help healing, and surgery is decided with the surgeons. This case does not record which vasodilator or wound care she received at the time.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 认出重叠病：MCTD诊断标准（如日本2019年标准，Tanaka 2021）以雷诺或手指、手肿胀加抗U1-RNP为基础，再看狼疮样、硬皮病样（硬指、间质性肺病、食管运动障碍或扩张）和肌炎样（无力、肌酶升高、肌源性肌电图）表现；肺动脉高压、无菌性脑膜炎和三叉神经病变是其特征性器官受累。本例雷诺、抗nRNP和硬指明确，食管和肺进一步提示硬皮病样受累；肌炎这一部分取决于同时记为56 U/L和556并标记升高的CK，以及显示明显变性伴血管扩张的肌肉病理。
teachingPoints.en: Recognising the overlap: MCTD criteria (for example the Japanese 2019 criteria, Tanaka 2021) start from Raynaud's or swollen fingers or hands with anti-U1-RNP and add overlap features — lupus-like, scleroderma-like (sclerodactyly, ILD, oesophageal dysmotility or dilatation) and myositis-like (weakness, raised muscle enzymes, a myopathic EMG); pulmonary arterial hypertension, aseptic meningitis and trigeminal neuropathy are its characteristic organ involvement. Here Raynaud's, anti-nRNP and sclerodactyly are clear and the oesophagus and lungs add scleroderma-like features; the myositis strand rests on a CK recorded both as 56 U/L and as 556 flagged raised, and on muscle pathology showing marked degeneration with vascular dilatation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 筛查器官而不是看CRP（SHARE 2021；ESC/ERS 2022肺动脉高压指南；ACR/CHEST 2023成人间质性肺病筛查指南）：SHARE 2021认为含DLCO的肺功能和HRCT是发现间质性肺病的敏感方法，青少年系统性硬化症至少每6个月查含DLCO的肺功能、超声心动图和肾功能；ESC/ERS 2022建议系统性硬化症每年评估肺动脉高压风险，有系统性硬化症重叠特征的结缔组织病可以考虑；ACR/CHEST 2023建议有硬皮病特征的成人MCTD在就诊时用肺功能和HRCT筛查，不用胸片。本例记录了限制性通气障碍、提示间质病变和食管扩张的CT及未见肺动脉高压的心超；DLCO、CT扫描方式和具体数值没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Screen the organs, not the CRP (SHARE 2021; ESC/ERS 2022 pulmonary hypertension guidelines; ACR/CHEST 2023 adult ILD screening guideline): SHARE 2021 names lung function with DLCO and HRCT as sensitive for ILD and asks for lung function with DLCO, echocardiography and renal function at least every 6 months in juvenile SSc; ESC/ERS 2022 recommends a yearly PAH risk evaluation in SSc and considers it in connective-tissue disease with SSc overlap features; ACR/CHEST 2023 screens adults with MCTD and SSc features at presentation with lung function and HRCT, not a chest X-ray. This case records a restrictive impairment, a CT raising interstitial disease with a dilated oesophagus and an echo without pulmonary hypertension; DLCO, the CT technique and the values are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 难治时如何升级（SHARE 2021；EULAR 2023）：SHARE 2021在活动性炎症期把激素与改善病情药联用，确诊时考虑甲氨蝶呤，甲氨蝶呤无效加用吗替麦考酚酯，心肺受累用环磷酰胺，严重或难治时考虑生物制剂（托珠单抗或利妥昔单抗），进展而难治时可考虑自体干细胞移植；EULAR 2023把甲氨蝶呤、吗替麦考酚酯或利妥昔单抗用于皮肤，把吗替麦考酚酯、环磷酰胺或利妥昔单抗用于间质性肺病。报告的经过——激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺和甲氨蝶呤后无明显改善，再加用利妥昔单抗——符合同样的升级思路；但单例、合并用药和一年随访不能证明好转是利妥昔单抗带来的。
teachingPoints.en: Escalating refractory disease (SHARE 2021; EULAR 2023): SHARE 2021 uses glucocorticoids with a DMARD in the active inflammatory phase, considers methotrexate at diagnosis, adds mycophenolate after methotrexate non-response, uses cyclophosphamide for cardiac or pulmonary involvement, considers biologics (tocilizumab or rituximab) in severe or refractory cases and autologous stem-cell transplantation for progressive refractory disease; EULAR 2023 lists methotrexate, mycophenolate or rituximab for skin and mycophenolate, cyclophosphamide or rituximab for ILD. The report's course — glucocorticoids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate without clear improvement, then rituximab added — follows the same logic of escalation, but one patient, concurrent treatment and a year of follow-up cannot show that rituximab caused the improvement.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 清除B细胞之前（利妥昔单抗说明书黑框警告，2013年FDA安全通报后加入；EULAR 2022成人感染筛查建议；EULAR/PReS 2021儿科疫苗建议；ACR 2022疫苗指南）：首次输注前查HBsAg和抗-HBc；开始抗风湿药物前明确乙肝状态，潜伏结核优先用IGRA筛查，HCV-RNA阳性者转诊治疗；在不推迟必要治疗的前提下于免疫抑制前接种疫苗，灭活疫苗安全，免疫抑制的患儿避免活疫苗，B细胞清除时疫苗应答下降；灭活疫苗与利妥昔单抗之间至少间隔2周。本病例没有记录用药前的筛查和疫苗；记录了随访1年没有过敏或感染。
teachingPoints.en: Before B-cell depletion (rituximab boxed warning, added after the FDA's 2013 safety communication; EULAR 2022 adult infection-screening recommendations; EULAR/PReS 2021 paediatric vaccination recommendations; ACR 2022 vaccination guideline): HBsAg and anti-HBc before the first infusion; HBV status defined before antirheumatic drugs, an IGRA preferred for latent TB and HCV-RNA-positive patients referred; vaccination before immunosuppression where it does not postpone necessary treatment, non-live vaccines safe, live vaccines avoided in immunosuppressed children and responses reduced on B-cell depletion; at least 2 weeks between a non-live vaccine and rituximab. This case records no screening or vaccination beforehand; it records no allergy or infection over one year.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 青少年与致畸、损伤生育力的药物：单独、保密地谈（HEADSS），询问月经和性生活；用甲氨蝶呤（其说明书要求开始前确认是否怀孕）、吗替麦考酚酯或环磷酰胺前查妊娠试验，讨论避孕和生育力保护——ACR 2020生殖健康指南有条件推荐绝经前女性每月静脉环磷酰胺时同时使用GnRH激动剂。她的月经、避孕和生育力保护本病例都没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: An adolescent on teratogenic and gonadotoxic drugs: see her alone and in confidence (HEADSS) about periods and sexual activity, test for pregnancy before methotrexate (whose label asks for pregnancy status to be verified before starting), mycophenolate or cyclophosphamide, and discuss contraception and fertility protection — the ACR 2020 reproductive health guideline conditionally recommends a GnRH agonist alongside monthly IV cyclophosphamide in premenopausal women. Her periods, contraception and any fertility protection are not recorded in this case.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例历史报告（2013年发表）不能证明某种治疗普遍有效或远期安全；报告的处置作为事实回顾，不代表今天的标准。病例中的处置选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的剂量。
boundaries.en: A single historical report (published 2013) cannot show that a treatment works in general or is safe in the long term; the report's care is reviewed as fact, not as today's standard. The management options are teaching reasoning, without doses for self-administration.

unknowns.zh-CN: 体重、身高、生命体征和血压。
unknowns.en: Weight, height, vital signs and blood pressure.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肾功能、尿常规、NT-proBNP和甲襞毛细血管镜。
unknowns.en: Kidney function, urinalysis, NT-proBNP and nailfold capillaroscopy.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肺功能的具体数值和DLCO，CT的扫描方式和间质改变的范围，利妥昔单抗之后的肺功能和CT。
unknowns.en: The lung-function values and DLCO, the CT technique and the extent of the interstitial change, and lung function or CT after rituximab.

unknowns.zh-CN: 哪一个CK值正确及其参考区间；各项检查的参考区间和B淋巴细胞计数的单位。
unknowns.en: Which CK value is right and its reference range; the reference ranges of all tests and the unit of the B-lymphocyte count.

unknowns.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素、免疫球蛋白、环磷酰胺、甲氨蝶呤和利妥昔单抗的剂量、途径、先后顺序和时间，以及同时继续使用了哪些药。
unknowns.en: The doses, routes, order and timing of the glucocorticoids, immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide, methotrexate and rituximab, and which drugs continued alongside.

unknowns.zh-CN: 用药前的乙肝、丙肝、HIV和结核筛查，疫苗接种史，免疫球蛋白水平。
unknowns.en: Hepatitis B and C, HIV and TB screening before treatment, her vaccination history and her immunoglobulin levels.

unknowns.zh-CN: 拇指是否愈合，僵硬在利妥昔单抗之后的变化，以及一年以后的病程。
unknowns.en: Whether the thumb healed, how her stiffness changed after rituximab, and the course beyond one year.

unknowns.zh-CN: 过敏史、月经和避孕情况、家族史和日常生活受影响的程度。
unknowns.en: Allergies, periods and contraception, family history and how her daily life is affected.
